name: echo
purpose: Print text to the terminal or write/append text into a file using redirection.
explanation: Outputs the given text. Combined with '>' it redirects output into a file and OVERWRITES existing content; combined with '>>' it APPENDS text to the end of the file.

parameters.description: Redirects output to a file, overwriting any existing content.
Redirects output to a file, appending to the end without overwriting.

whenToUse: To write quick text or script lines into a file or print messages in scripts.
commonMistakes: Using '>' when you meant '>>' and accidentally overwriting the entire file.
